110000.description:
Arama's got a passion for exorcising demons, but he's a little short on talent. Making matters worse, he's constantly being judged by another more powerful exorcist, Chiruha Yaso. Can he ever live up to her lofty expectations and actually put away some evil spirits for good?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.english: Inishie no Horobimon: Ancient Ruined Crests

110001.description: Toki loves his childhood friend Hisamitsu. He decides to keep his feelings hidden to be able to stay by his side. So he`s watching him getting married and having a child, but then...

110002.description: Natsume is a hardworking and serious office worker. Yuuki is almost his polar opposite, and someone that he never expected to get along with. But Yuuki’s kindness wins him over, and he falls in love with his carefree coworker. But what will happen when Yuuki discovers Natsume is in love with him...?
synonyms: Can I Touch Your Inside Deeply?

title.native: 奥まで触れてもいいですか
title.romaji: Oku Made Furete mo Ii Desu ka

110003.description:
In the lawless Arang Technical High School, Kim-gu simply hopes to lead his life as a "good student"...

(Source: Naver, translated)

110005.description: An ordinary couple's every day life.

110006.description: A lamb surrounded by wolves gets a guard dog. But is the guard dog the most dangerous wolf of them all?!

110007.description: Having to work a part time job in a Bom-Mart, Hajun gets harassed by his manager Wookyung without a reason. One day, he was ordered by Wookyung to arrange the cold storage and gets trapped with Wookyung, who came to check on him. But thinking that they'll die in the cold storage, Wookyung suddenly starts to confess to Hajun that he harassed him because he liked him?!

110008.description:
Based on Wes Anderson's Isle of Dogs film.

Isle of Dogs tells the story of Atari Kobayashi, 12-year-old ward to corrupt Mayor Kobayashi. When, by Executive Decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire prefecture.

(Source: Berlin International Film Festival)

110009.description:
Kokoro is a junior high school student—but after years of bullying, she’s become so anxious that she no longer goes to school. One day, she’s pulled through her full-length mirror into a castle in another dimension by a girl in a wolf mask. The mysterious girl tells Kokoro and six other kids that they are all competing in a scavenger hunt. If one of them finds a key that unlocks a secret room, that person will get one wish granted. As long as they observe the rules of the world, they can come and go as they please. The seven kids gradually grow closer as they explore the castle, but the scavenger hunt is never far from anyone’s mind. After all, only one of them can win and receive their heart’s desire.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The Solitary Castle in the Mirror
Le château solitaire dans le miroir
El castillo a través del espejo
El castillo a través del espejo

title.native: プリンセスに転生したけどあまりに向いてないのでひきこもります
title.romaji: Princess ni Tensei Shita Kedo Amari ni Muitenai no de Hikikomorimasu

110011.description:
Orphans Charlotte and William finally confess their feelings for each other and promised to be together forever. Yet, Charlotte is suddenly killed in a motor accident, leaving William devastated. Death is usually the end of most relationships, but it seems that Will has other plans...

Includes 1 bonus chapter.

title.native: 愛しの故・シャーロット

110012.description:
Long ago, the Chosen One defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the world...not that it matters to ordinary high school student Hironori Tabata. But word is the Demon King's coming back, and the only thing that can stop him is what's in Hironori's pants. Before long, demi-human girls are throwing themselves at him, hoping to give birth to the next Chosen One, and Hironori has to worry more about saving his chastity for the girl he loves than saving the world!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters
synonyms: To Save the World, Can You Lie in Bed With Me, a Subhuman, in the Morning?
世界を救うために亜人(わたし)と朝チュンできますか？

title.english: To Save the World, Can You Wake Up the Morning After with a Demi-Human?
title.native: 世界を救うために亜人と朝チュンできますか?
title.romaji: Sekai wo Sukuu Tame ni Watashi to Asa Chun Dekimasu ka?

title.native: 学生寮はあやかしやしき

110014.description:
What has a vampire who just woke up from a long sleep encountered... A zombie?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

110015.description:
Should a doctor save the body or the soul? Chu Han was the idiot among fellow elite medical students who had even never considered such a question. One day, his life was flipped upside down when he met an alleged genius but insane doctor ghost.

(Source: Webnovel)

110017.description:
Junwoo, a hikikomori, passes his days alone, nestled within the darkness of his room that protects him from the outside world. The one strand of light capable of piercing his world is Hanbit, his neighbor and love interest. But when Hanbit leaves to study abroad, Junwoo is forced to take on a roommate to make ends meet. Could this break to his routine be the very thing that Junwoo needs to free himself of his darkness?

(Source: Lezhin)

110018.description:
Haruki is a school nurse by day, natural-born manhunter by night. Lately, though, he hasn't been able to catch any prey. As his frustration reaches a boiling point, he is approached by a mysterious young man named Shion. "Give it up. I'm only gonna stop you." Haruki laughs this off, believing it to be some kind of immature revenge plot. Shion seizes this opportunity to push Haruki down and bind his hands. In a state of rapture, Shion says, "I've been told I'm pretty good. So, all you gotta do is sit back and take it." Despite not usually being on the receiving end, Haruki can't help but lose himself to the pleasure...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: エロトマニアックプレイ

110019.description:
As a member of the discipline committee, Akira makes a round of the school every day after class. Even though he'd planned on going home after a quick check, his finding Mitsuru, another second year, coming out of an unused room completely changes his life. Learning that, out of boredom, Mitsuru calls other students to empty classrooms after school to do naughty things, Akira warns him to stop before he ends up getting in trouble. But not only does Mitsuru not heed his warning, he gets even wilder... Can this naughty and twisted friendship develop into something more ?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ともだちひとりできるかな

110020.description:
"I bought you for thousand dollars." Akane was abandoned by her mother as a little girl and treated as a nuisance by the family members that were forced to raise her. She's always held firm to the belief that one day she'll find happiness, but is shocked to learn the man she thought was her destiny is already married! Accused of having an affair, she's being forced to provide compensation. Just then, a man in a suit suddenly appears and claims to be her husband!?

(Source: Renta!)

110021.description:
Mika isn't accustomed to romance, but then she meets the handsome cafe manager, Kyosuke. It's love at first sight, and she's been chasing after him ever since... Every day, he's curt and unrelentingly cold towards her. She likes those cool traits, too, though! Then, one night, after accidentally finding her way inside his house, an intoxicated Kyosuke pins her down! That night, the normally cold, classy gentleman suddenly turns naughty!! When he plays with her there... it feels so good she can barely even think...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: If It's Love, Don't Fight It -At Night, This Perfect Gentleman Turns Wicked-
title.native: 恋ならもう仕方ない～極上男子は今夜もイジワル
title.romaji: Koi Nara Mou Shikatanai: Gokujou Danshi wa Konya mo Ijiwaru

110022.description:
Goddess has made Ein reincarnate as a nobleman--a big chance. However, the skill he got from her "Toxin Decomposition EX" is a lame one. One day Ein learns that he has a very rare talent which makes him able to absorb magic power by eating magic stones. Also he is told that he has other identity as a prince of the largest kingdom. With his loving, beautiful mother and clever fiancee at his side, Ein's quest to become the King begins--!

(Source: Kadokawa)
synonyms: 魔石グルメ 魔物の力を食べたオレは最強!
Maseki Gourmet: Mamono no Chikara o Tabeta Ore wa Saikyou!

title.english: Magic Stone Gourmet: Eating Magical Power Made Me The Strongest
title.native: 魔石グルメ ～魔物の力を食べたオレは最強！～
title.romaji: Maseki Gourmet: Mamono no Chikara wo Tabeta Ore wa Saikyou!

110024.description:
When what you think is an advantage is actually a burden to someone else.

(Source: Manga Rock)

title.native: 僕らのコンプレックス

110025.description:
A collection of short stories.

1. Girlist Beast
2. Back Lash
3. Virgin Beauty
4. Iroha: Sweet
5. Junk/Jewel
6. Onna Futari no Arifureta Nichijou

Note: There also exists an older version from 2009 with less content.

110026.description: Aya and Hisaki share a connection that goes beyond that of a normal master and his familiar: they're also a dysfunctional brother and sister duo who are constantly at each others' throats! But when a face from Hisaki's past threatens to tear them apart, will they be able to keep from strangling each other long enough to see each other through?
synonyms: A Sorcerer Entered into a Contract

110029.description: After Rimuru's encounter with Shizu-san in the manga, he learns how to mimic a human form. However, the body......was that of a three-year-old child!? With chibi-Rimuru and his friends unleashed from the Great Forest of Jura, maternal instincts hit in the "Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken" Official 3rd Spin-Off!
synonyms: Tenchura! That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime

title.native: 転ちゅら！ 転生したらスライムだった件
title.romaji: Tenchura! Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken

110030.description:
"It is not just "bullying."
Nakajima was ruling over the class as a bully. The subject of bullying is a fragile girl called Shirasaki-san. Going as far as violence, every day was horrible. Everyone in the class pretends to not see it. If they try to stop him, then they will be the next target. Nakajima engages in bullying as if possessed. It was clear that something was wrong. Why does he do such brutal acts? The truth was terrible...

110031.description:
“A doctor is never off duty. Every day of the year, every hour of every day.”

Even though his enemy is the corrupted medical world, Jou Busujima, the highly-skilled rumored surgeon will never turn down any patient!

(Source: Manga Club)

title.english: Kizuna: Hand of God Unbound by The Heavens

110032.description: I, Han Ji-An, am already struggling as a no-name actress. To make matters worse, I ended up falling down the stairs and dying because of superstar Ji So-Won’s fanclub. However, in reality, Ji So-Won is a grim reaper trying to take me to the afterlife!? That can't possibly be true!? I’m not ready to leave this life. No. It shouldn't be me!

110033.description: After coming to her cousin's house per her father's request to seduce Kousuke in order for him to win a free tractor, she finds out that him and his fiancé had broken up since she loves another man.

110034.description: A girl harboring feelings for her childhood friend receives some help from little balls of fluff... For better or for worse.

110035.description: Exceptionally talented with makeup, a young and beautiful beauty merchant, Sohwa, plays a decisive role with a courtesan who wants to be married by an influential politician. Love, intrigues, power games and seduction in Korea of the late seventeenth century.
synonyms: 売粉嫗ー化粧師ユナー（メブング）

110037.description: Hosokawa-san who worries about being too skinny and Oota-san who is overweight and has a cheerful personality are good friends who work in the same company. One is unable to tell what her boyfriend is really thinking and the other is made fun of by their handsome boss who places one's appearance over their character. Can love be found by staying as you are, or is it something you must change yourself for?

110040.description:
Sato is my roommate, and also my best friend. How come I feel like kissing him? I have to stop falling for...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 三上と里はまだやましくない
title.romaji: Mikami to Sato wa Mada Yamashikunai

110041.description:
Best friends Yeong and Nohae thought it was a joke when they downloaded the infamous “cursed” app. It’s said to command the user to perform…sexual acts and punishes those who disobey or delete it. It started with making them kiss. When they disobeyed its order…the punishment was anything but a joke. Yeong is just a mild-mannered twenty something. Nohae is an award-winning male model, superstar, and now, thanks to the app, sexual deviant. Can they survive the app’s dirty commands? Or will it continue to shame them or even worse…

(Source: Tapas)

110042.description:
Sung-Hoon Lee is nothing but a victim of a changing world, a powerless man in a land infested with beasts and magic. Monsters from another world invaded earth, and they brought with them a sickness that pushes Sung-Hoon’s mother into an endless sleep. To pay off her medical bills, he braved a dangerous job as bait used by powerful superhumans called Awakeners to hunt monsters. But when he found himself at death’s door, the image of his past life flashes through his mind. There, he found his truth: he is the reincarnation of the Sorcerer King!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

110043.description:
Father Daniel is a new teacher at Kaebiji Private High School, a school that is known for being a dump where all the local delinquents gather. He is adjusting to his new life well until one night when he stumbles upon a woman while on patrol… and finds her beating a man. Sensing that something is off, Father Daniel reports the incident to the faculty the next day, only to realize that the woman, Miss Sasha, is also a teacher at the school. A strange relationship between a devoted priest and a kind teacher both disguised as angels begins...

(Source: WEBTOONS)

110044.description: Saku Hanafusa is the handsome son of a corporate boss. I'm just an ordinary girl from an ordinary family. But I'm working as a caretaker at Saku's home because he's totally dependent on me, and he sticks to me at school and at home. It's about time for Saku to grow up and fend for himself!
synonyms: 花房同學對你中毒很深

title.native: 花房くんはキミ依存症

110045.description:
In this world there is exactly the same amount of "last moments" as there is anything alive. Because 16-year-old Mamoru Kaname has the power to see someone's "last moment" just by touching them, he is feared as the "Grim Reaper." One day, upon seeing the "last moment" of Kana Shiraishi, a classmate he had fallen for, Mamoru does everything he can to change fate, but...!?

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

110046.description: Anemone is just like all the other flowers at the flower shop until Akiko, a woman he's already fallen in love with, takes him to her home.

110047.description:
As a reporter, Clark has interviewed many criminals but never a murderer. Enter Alex, the Triage Killer. A serial killer who kills in three, he agrees to an interview so long as Clark offers one thing in return: himself. Murder after murder, question after question, Clark will learn why Alex kills. And Alex… he will learn Clark isn’t as innocent as he seems.

(Source: Tapas)

110048.description: When "Nice Guy" Asai Manatsu's marriage proposal gets rejected, he thinks his day can't get any worse, until a Knight in Skull helmet tries to kill him! He's saved by a beautiful, silver-haired swords-woman and told to flee, but his nice guy impulses are too strong and he saves her from an attack, getting himself killed in the process. As he dies he wishes to be reborn in a world where people won't judge him for taking care of others...

title.native: さまよえる転生者たちのリライブルゲーム

110049.description:
Koganei Koito is a teenager who works as an attendant to the Takamimi Shrine. Rumors have it that a deity dwells within the shrine, but the actual resident is an immortal elf who found herself stuck on Earth some four hundred years ago. What’s more, the elf is a total shut-in who won’t go outside…and has developed a taste for video games! Now the attendants at the shrine have to cater to the elf’s love of the most modern gizmos–from handheld games to virtual reality headsets–in this charming fantasy comedy!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

110051.description: This love relationship is only through smartphone technology and how the characters fight to keep the relationship safe. Technology simply plays a supporting role in this relationship and our protagonists are two people who are shy in love.

title.native: スマホに君がいるキセキ
title.romaji: Smartphone ni Kimi ga Iru Kiseki

110052.description: Mizuho was recently confessed to by the cheerful Hayami, but being the negative Mizuho, she is not convinced. Will Hayami's love change Mizuho's mind?

title.native: だって、どうせ、でも、きっと

110056.description:
The year is 20XX. Japan has entered an unprecedented age of declining birth rates, and the government's countermeasures have all failed... As a last resort, a new experimental law will be introduced, implementing a "free sex day," which some fear will turn men into uncontrollable animals. Ayuri, a student at an all-girls university, and her handsome boyfriend Satoshi were a couple that remained true to their pure love, but will they be dragged into this madness and have their relationship torn apart!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Day Men Become Animals -Get Those Girls Pregnant-
title.native: オトコが野獣に目覚める日～日本中でフリーに子作りしましょ☆
title.romaji: Otoko ga Yajuu ni Mezameru Hi: Nihonjuu de Free ni Kozukuri Shimasho☆

110057.description:
A family takes part in a semi-annual feast.

This oneshot is found in Awesome Fellows! Perfect.

110058.description:
Tsukiwaka might be a fan of cute and girly things, but actually he can’t handle women well. One day, a strange, beautiful woman named Hinako showed up on his campus. She handed a hand-made lunch box to Tsukiwaka while smiling, “I am your wife.”
Since he is bad with women, Tsukiwaka thought he could resist such an unexpected self-declaration, but why does Hinako make his heart race? Should Tsukiwaka go along with her play?

(Source: Manga.Club)

110059.description:
Every novel has the usual cast: a gorgeous heroine, handsome boys vying for her attention, and a homely best friend at the heroine’s side. Dan-I, an ordinary student and avid reader of internet novels, is all too familiar with these tropes. But she never imagined that one day she’d wake up at the center of one herself! Her new fictional world is complete with a beautiful best friend named Yeo- Ryeong, and four impossibly good-looking boys who all happen to be in her class. Dan-I is determined to stay out of the way and not get involved in the twists and turns of the plot. But is she really just the sidekick -- or is Dan-I actually the leading lady? Anything is possible in the world of a novel!

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)
synonyms: ลุ้นหัวใจยัยตัวประกอบ

title.english: My Life as an Internet Novel

110060.description: Three years after joining the workforce, Ken Inubosaki is 24 years old, single, with a measly 89,000 yen in savings, living the miserable life of an overworked wage-slave. When he passed out on the street from overwork and drinking, he was picked up by a beautiful JK girl and blackmailed into becoming her "pet"?
synonyms: A High School Girl Raises a Corporate Slave

110062.description:
When a “god” tells Tsukina that she is to be transported to another world to become its savior, Tsukina isn’t interested. As a bookish thirty-something, she has zero desire to go on some big adventure…so when she arrives in the strange new land, she decides to use her magical powers to create a cozy little book café instead. But when a fellow “savior” starts causing trouble, Tsukina might just have to play the hero, after all!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.
synonyms: I Was Summoned to Another World as a Savior, but Because I’m a Woman in My Thirties That’s Impossible, so I Quietly Started a Book Café
The Savior's Book Café in Another World
สาวสามสิบไม่เป็นแล้วผู้กล้าไปเปิดบุ๊คคาเฟ่ที่ต่างโลกดีกว่า
雖然作為救世主被召喚到異世界，但因年過30，只好來偷開咖啡廳。
Mein Buchcafé in einer anderen Welt

title.english: The Savior’s Book Cafe Story in Another World
title.native: 異世界に救世主として喚ばれましたが、アラサーには無理なので、ひっそりブックカフェ始めました。
title.romaji: Isekai ni Kyuuseishu to Shite Yobaremashita ga, Arasa ni wa Muri nano de, Hissori Book Cafe Hajimemashita.

110063.description: New enemies, new bugs and an even bigger island.

110065.description:
Hokkaido Prefectural Police detective Ryohei Akutsu is investigating the "Box-Folding Serial Murders" that occurred eight years ago. Despite the bewildered looks of those around him, he diligently pursues the case, and during this time he meets throat physician Akihisa Shikane. A quiet and capable doctor, Shikane promises to cooperate. Meanwhile, Akutsu is tormented by internal conflicts within the Hokkaido Prefectural Police...and Shikane is, in fact, the "Box-Folding Killer" himself!! An apocalyptic crime suspense story colored with blood, violence, and memories begins here!!

(Source: Shinchosha, machine translated)

Notes:
-The series was canceled in 2019 and was originally collected in four volumes. In 2024, the author released a fifth volume to conclude the series.
-The chapter count includes three extras.

110067.description: Chinatsu and her swimming coach have had a platonic relationship for over a year and the time for them to finally have sex has come.

110068.description: A high school girl is bored with her everyday life.

title.native: 明日も世界はいつも通り
title.romaji: Ashita mo Sekai wa Itsumo Doori

110069.description: Contains a one page short by Minami Katase called "Somosomo kanojo wa saikou nanda ga megane ga kougekiryoku wo ageru to wa omotteimasen deshita."

110070.description:
Just another office lady trying to get by.

(Source: TSP)

title.native: 平日ナイトフィーバー

110071.description:
I'm writing to you again today as a friend with trust and love. I hope that when you receive this letter, you will think of me. Whenever I remember you, I am filled with such longing, agony, and affection.

Romance Sonata - A collection of short love stories.

Story #1 - Rowen's Red Roofed House
Story #2 - Gift
Story #3 - Andvas' Treasure
Story #4 - Loss and Love
Story #5 - Milky Dragon

110072.description:
One cold winter night, Haesa seeks shelter in an old house in the mountains, where she meets a slumbering stranger named Yuan. That's when tragedy begins to befall Haesa’s friends, plunging the young girl into a sad and lonely youth. Ten years later, as Yuan starts to regain his lost memories, he realizes that this cursed fate goes back much further, to a time only he can recall. But with sinister forces at play, will they be able to break the toxic cycle and step into the warmth of spring?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes a prologue and four side story chapters.
synonyms: เหมันต์ทมิฬ

110075.description:
An angel made a mistake, resulting in Shiihara Daiki’s death. In order to hide the mistake, he was then sent to a different world. The angel will grant him one wish as a payment for keeping it a secret. Daiki asked for a Heavenly Castle floating in the sky without hesitation.

Suddenly a floating castle appeared in the new world, which causes confusion amongst the people. They attempt to contact Daiki in various ways. A country tries to steal it by force, while another seeks to befriend him. What in the world would Daiki do?

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Tenkuu no Shiro o Moratta no de Isekai de Tanoshiku Asobitai
I wanted to play in another world because I received the castle in the sky

title.native: 天空の城をもらったので異世界で楽しく遊びたい
title.romaji: Tenkuu no Shiro wo Moratta no de Isekai de Tanoshiku Asobitai

110078.description:
Wan Jia, the protagonist, was killed in the game KOG by a sneak attack from his own teammate and therefore disqualified. However, the moment he left the game, he went back to one year ago, the first day of this game. This time he'll never trust anyone easily! This is for revenge! And more importantly, for winning the game!

(Source: Webnovel)

synonyms: The Work of the XX Committee

110080.description:
A man wakes up and realizes he’s become a subject in a human experiment.

(Source: LSD)

110084.description:
The Metropolitan Police Department's Special Investigation Section Six has a secret weapon in their arsenal - rookie detective Minami Asako. Asako has a very special "condition" that causes him to copy the wounds and pains of the dead onto his own body. While Asako's special talent of "becoming" the victim might have helped solve many cases before, will it help this time, when the victim is Kuroiwa's ex-wife?

(Source: futekiya)
synonyms: Stigmata - Les empreintes de la passion

110085.description: Follows the trials and tribulations of Agawa Kayo, a volunteer probation officer.

110086.description:
Niko Nanase has a secret: Although she's a first-year student at a VIP private high school, she herself works part-time jobs whenever she can to make ends meet for herself and her two younger sisters. However, when high-school hottie and tv-drama star Leon finds out about her double-life, she thinks she's ruined...until he proposes a solution to her money problems: Be his maid!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: メイド・イン・ハニー

110087.description:
"I just wanted to make an alpha like you pant."

An omegaverse story where an alpha from an elite family who hates omegas meets an alpha who is too carefree. Tsukasa is the ideal alpha: he was raised in an elite family and now works in his father's company. One day, he happens to meet Yoshiki, a fellow alpha and former high school classmate, who he once saw as a rival. However, he is surprised to discover that the aloof Yoshiki is living a carefree, unprofessional life that is completely atypical for an alpha. They go out drinking to celebrate their reunion, and Yoshiki has a few too many, prompting Tsukasa to help him get home. That's when Yoshiki seizes the chance to entice Tsukasa: "Being with another alpha can be fun, too."

Even though he is against it at first, Tsukasa eventually gives in to the frenzy of pleasure and gets carried away in a relationship that isn't just a one-time thing. He figures that he can stop this kind of infertile relationship anytime he wants...That is, until he notices changes within his body...

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: イミテーションメイト

110091.description: A short story about a man, his wife, and the memories they once shared together.

title.native: ウチの妻は忘れっぽい

110092.description:
A unique combination of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" and "food"!　Did you know that Kongming made steamed buns? A family of "Three Kingdoms" otaku who run a Chinese restaurant were trying to recreate dishes from "The Annals of the Three Kingdoms" when are transported back to the era of the Three Kingdoms! The book is full of foodie stories about the famed generals and commanders of the period! Recipes for dishes that appear in the work are also included at the end of the book!

(Source: usio Publishing, translated)

title.native: ノンケのトモダチにワタシのｘｘが狙われています
title.romaji: Nonke no Tomodachi ni Watashi no xx ga Nerawareteimasu

110094.description: Despite having no connections and oppositions from her family, Shin Chae-rin went to practice medicine as an intern at Migang Hospital. There she meets a doctor by the name of Baek Kangwoo who has everything in his favor yet wants to give up his training. This is a love story blossoming in the emergency room where Chaerin struggles with her daily work and her love for Kangwoo.
synonyms: Emergency! How to Deal with Love

110095.description:
After being worked to the bone at her office job, getting introduced to her longtime crush’s new girlfriend, and dealing with her family’s debt hanging over her head, Hari Shin's life seems to have hit rock bottom. Luckily, her friend Youngseo has a business proposal for her: go to an arranged date in her stead and Hari will receive a hefty compensation. Things grow complicated, however, when it turns out that the other party is Hari’s new CEO—and he's dead-set on marrying whoever shows up to the date!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: お見合い相手はうちのボス
I Got a Date with the President

110096.description: Mika loves taking photos and to make money, she sells secret photos of the popular Yuuki. Annoyed, Yuuki confronts her, but Mika gets her way and decides she will take full coverage photos of him (ie follow him). Will Mika get the shots that she wanted, or more?

title.native: 1/2000秒の恋 私だけに見せて
title.romaji: 1-2000 Byou no Koi: Watashi Dake ni Misete

110097.description:
With the screech of rubber and a crunch of metal, Dojin departs the mortal world, leaving behind his beloved sister and niece. He awakens in the kingdom of Yooguk, where the people call him “emperor” and serve a god named Yellow Dragon. Dojin soon discovers that Yellow Dragon called him to Yooguk for a purpose: to share his “life force” and protect the kingdom. As Dojin slips deeper into Yellow Dragon’s cold embrace, how far will he go in order to get back home?

(Source: Lezhin)

110098.description: A collection of somewhat surreal oneshots featuring human-like bugs in otherwise normal rural/historical settings.

110099.description:
Have you ever been confused about love? In the end what is "true love" like? Our female lead now is standing at a fork in the road. On one side, her close childhood friend is waiting for her reply. On the other side, there stands her college friend whom she cannot just let go. Where does this love triangle lead to?

(Source: Webcomics)

110100.description: In The Unwomanly Face of War, Alexievich chronicles the experiences of the Soviet women who fought on the front lines, on the home front, and in the occupied territories. These women—more than a million in total—were nurses and doctors, pilots, tank drivers, machine-gunners, and snipers. They battled alongside men, and yet, after the victory, their efforts and sacrifices were forgotten.
synonyms: Sensou wa Onna no Kao wo Shite Inai

title.native: 戦争は女の顔をしていない
title.romaji: Sensou wa Onna no Kao wo Shiteinai

synonyms: The Yukionna in the Lingering Summer Heat

110102.description:
Shiro reluctantly joined a special boys' boarding school where only the Crown Prince and selected schoolmates are allowed. But then he immediately got into trouble with a beautiful boy in the restroom and was threatened with expulsion…

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)
synonyms: 金の釦 銀の襟（きんのぼたん ぎんのえり）
Kin no Botan Gin no Eri
Kin no Botan, Gin no Eri

title.romaji: Kin no Button, Gin no Eri: Palace Meidi Sokubun

110103.description:
Serialization of the original doujinshi with the same title

When Akari is sent to live with her mom's old friend, she's surprised to find that the hard-working Touko-san she's heard so much about is actually a reckless adult with no knowledge of housekeeping whatsoever! What's to become of Akari now that she's a highschooler with the world's most unreliable roommate?

title.native: 塔子さんは家事ができない。

110104.description:
Sosuke Aoyama is a college student adrift on his own...until a chance meeting with suibokuga artist Kozan Shinoda brings him into the world of India-ink painting. But though he finds connection with the art and Shinoda himself, there's more to both the art world and Shinoda's family than Sosuke realizes...

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: เส้นสายลายชีวิต

title.romaji: Ten no Hana Kuni no Shinwa

110106.description: From the appearance to the voice, a shop whose business is to assume the client's identity and act in their place, Gekkousha.

110107.description:
When Aki receives an offer from Ayumu, an attractive college student he has a crush on, to move into a shared house with him, he immediately jumps at the opportunity. Joining Aki in the move is Taichi, a close friend who always looks out for him. Excited at the prospect of living in close proximity to Ayumu, Aki soon allows himself to become an outlet for Ayumu's dirty desires. However, when Taichi catches them both in the act, Ayumu brazenly invites him to "join in" the festivities...!!

(Source: Renta!)

110108.description: In her campus life, full of ups and downs, she may have a magnificent appearance, but in reality, she has the most timid personality.

110109.description:
Always doing her best to avoid any connection to internal powers in the company until she retires, Mo Taehee. 
Cha Soohyeok, the general manager who has overcome all kinds of obstacles, finally finds his way to be the CEO. 
The love and shameful(?) story of a young man and woman, who spent one night in a secluded cottage with their own secrets, unfolds!

110110.description: A one-shot based on IZ*ONE Won-Young’s time on Produce48.

Male student Sota Tsukishima begins working at his family's public bathhouse as a back washer. While concealing her true identity, Sota's classmate Aoi Yuzuki visits the bathhouse. A relationship between the two begins to develop when Sota washes Aoi's back.

Volume 5: Asoko Araiya-san!: Biyaku de Mezameru Kyuuai Shoudou (アソコ洗い屋さん！～媚薬で目覚める求愛衝動～)
Volume 6: Asoko Araiya-san!: Danjo ga Sakaru Rankou Onsen (アソコ洗い屋さん！～男女がサカる乱交温泉～)

The Job of Washing That Part

110112.description:
One woman’s life is changed forever when she meets a man who truly has that dog in him!

Rikka, a dog groomer with a gift for taming wild pups, finds her life turned upside down when the Doberman she rescues one night suddenly turns into a hunky guy! This dog-man is on the prowl for a mate and chooses Rikka–and he’s not holding back his horndog desire. Can Rikka resist his puppy eyes, or will she be caught in his leash of love?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

110113.description:
Everything is going wrong for high schooler Ena, locally renowned for her super strength, when her life takes a strange turn. She becomes the betrothed of the unexpectedly gorgeous Sakae, a bodyguard and heir to a major security company. But is she jumping out of the frying pan, and into the ready, aim―fire?! He strikes a bargain to pay off her family's debts after two months, as long as she she agrees to certain, steamy…conditions. Can Ena make this relationship of convenience work, without getting in too deep?!

(Source: One Peace Books)

Note: Chapter count includes 8 volume-bonus chapters and a Special Short.

110116.description:
1935, Chidori Art School, a place where boys studying theater gather. Keitarou Chidori, a boy who strives harder than anyone else to achieve his dream of "wanting to stand in the center of the stage and become a star", and a new student, Setsu Mugimaki, who appears in front of him holding a deep secret. The story surrounding the concept of "talent" is now ringing the opening bell. The latest work by Yukizou Saku, depicting theatrical geniuses vs. geniuses! Can hard work surpass talent?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: God, look back at me please

110117.description: My day is not going well. First a girl won’t leave me alone. Then she’s all over another guy. Sheesh!

title.native: となりの巫女おねーさん

synonyms: My Prince from the Garden of Eden

110122.description:
"What would you do if I told you I always wanted to be alone with you...?" "We've been friends forever!" Me, Aki and Tetsuji have been friends since we were kids. We all love games and we're always together. But everything changed once we got to experience a game called "Real Game"... with a love setting, nonetheless! Tetsuji and Aki ignored my questions completely and just went ahead, making me the main character of the game. Kissing in secret, getting teased in a closet...! This is a virtual love game that seems too real, played by three guys and I'm the only one reacting!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: NC-17 Boys Playing a Girls' Game -Huh!? I'm the Bottom!?-
title.native: 【18禁】男たちの乙女ゲー♂え!? 俺が受け?!
title.romaji: [18 Kin] Otoko-tachi no Otomege ♂ E!? Ore ga Uke?!

110123.description:
"We could just go to the hotel now, right?" Hiroto went and signed up with a dating agency when he was heartbroken, and the match he ended up with was a much younger, very cute girl! Their compatibility turns out to be 200%! They get along fine when she invites him to go to a hotel, and their bodies end up being a perfect match as well. Hiroto is overjoyed! However, when he meets up with her again, the person before him turns out to be a pretty boy who claims to have the same name! This manga has boys-love and teens-love elements in it.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 運命の相手がややこしい！

110125.description:
In the kingdom of Artoria, only one lucky woman will be able to become the consort of the crown prince. Such is the premise of the hit romance game that everyone's been playing. But, Cosette isn't your average gamer... she's a housewife that's been reborn not as the hero, or even as a rival, but as a generic background character! Cosette is doomed for a bad ending if she doesn't do something about her situation, fast!
But as she finds herself drawn into the intrigue of the upper classes, she also finds herself getting closer to the crown prince himself! What will happen to Cosette in this mixed-up love comedy?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: I Think I'll Quit Being the Villainess' Follower
I Will Quit the Entourage of the Villaines

title.english: Beating the Heroine at Her Own Game
title.native: 悪役令嬢の取り巻きやめようと思います
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou no Torimaki Yameyou to Omoimasu

110126.description:
Astrid von Oldenburg is no ordinary four-year-old. She’s a child prodigy with a passion for military technology who now finds herself reincarnated in the world of an otome game she played during her past life. But not as the heroine! As the game’s villainess, she's born with wealth, power, and a fearsome talent for magic. The only problem is that every route leads to her inevitable destruction. Or does it? What if averting her destruction was a simple matter of amassing enough firepower to annihilate anyone who dared even attempt to bring her down?! In a bid to resist fate, the young villainess embarks on the reproduction of all of her favorite weaponry. Whatever it takes, Astrid’s determined to blow away her bad ends with superior firepower!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The Villainess Will Crush Her Destruction End Through Modern Firepower

title.english: Villainess: Reloaded! ~Blowing Away Bad Ends with Modern Weapons~
title.native: どうしても破滅したくない悪役令嬢が現代兵器を手にした結果がこれです
title.romaji: Doushitemo Hametsu Shitakunai Akuyaku Reijou ga Gendai Heiki wo Te ni Shita Kekka ga Kore desu

110128.description:
After being overworked to death, Ronia was reincarnated as a villainess in a certain novel world. She knows that her engagement will be cancelled and she will be banished from the center stage. However, she wants to spend a peaceful and relaxing time in this world! After being banished according to the novel, Ronia opens a coffee shop in the countryside with the help of small fairies called Loto. Then, unique beastmen come to her shop one after another...? This is a relaxing life of a former villainess!!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

title.english: My Lady Just Wants to Relax
title.native: 令嬢はまったりをご所望

110129.description:
Collection of oneshots, originally self-published and/or released in Pink Gold anthologies, except chapter 7 which is new for this release.

1. Purism (ピュアイズム)
Crow saves Dr. Dias from wild dogs and this "man-lover" doctor falls in love with him at first sight. Trying to get rid of Dias, Crow does many things but being more persistent than himself, he cannot prevent him from doing "weird" things. What will happen after these two start to live together?

2. Pet Keiyaku (Pet 契約, Pet contract.)
A young man offers to sell himself at auction in order to obtain the money for his brother's medical care, but before he goes on the block, he needs some training...

3. Kinbaku: Mamoru-hen (緊縛 ーマモル編ー)
4. Kinbaku: Takaya-hen (緊縛 ータカヤ編ー)

5. Mob #1 for Jack
Jack is going to do his military service. Before he has to go, his father wants him one more time.

6. Mob #2 for Jack
Short time after starting the military service, another soldier is blackmailing Jack to be his plaything.

7. Pet Keiyaku Sonogo (Pet契約その後)

110132.description: After getting groped and sexually harassed during work, Miyabi is saved by her crush, Akitaka and is brought into the back room to recuperate.

110133.description: After Akitaka is caught having tons of female acquaintances, Miyabi gets jealous of how close they are and decides he needs to be punished.

110134.description: Spin-off manga from Lupin III depicting Ishikawa Goemon.

title.native: 十三代目 石川五ェ門

110135.description:
Having moved schools frequently throughout his childhood, Fujino has perfected the art of the false smile. Now his fifth school, his well-mannered smile is safely helping him make new friends, but one day, on the school roof, he finds a scarred boy sleeping there. That boy is the “Mad Dog”, the student all his classmates are afraid of. While Fujino is observing him, the boy opens his eyes, and then…

A youthful love story between an unsociable yankee and a ‘good boy’ honour student.
synonyms: Me wa Kuchi Hodoni Koi to iu
Eyes Speak More Love Than the Mouth
Ánh mắt thay lời yêu thương

title.native: 目は口ほどに恋という
title.romaji: Me wa Kuchi Hodo ni Koi to Iu

110137.description:
Eden is a member of the Timekeeper family, who possess the ability to travel back in time. Their date of death has been set since the day they were born... and the summer of 2018 is when Eden is destined to die. On that fateful day, he decides to confess his feelings to his longtime crush. But Jay, who is straight and only cherishes Eden as a friend, is flustered by Eden’s confession and reacts badly. Caught up in his thoughts, Eden is met with a fatal accident—and thus his time travel begins. He finds himself on the last day of the high school summer camp training where he first met Jay. Given the opportunity, will Eden be able to change anything that happened on that day, 20 years ago?

Note: Part of Kidari Entertainment's "Yeoreumdanpyeonseon: Some in Summer (~키다리이엔티 여름단편선~ 썸인썸머, Kidari Entertainment Summer Short Story Collection: Some in Summer)"

110138.description:
Satoru is a playwright for a theater company, and Itsuki is an actor inspired by Satoru to pursue a career in the theater. They are troubled by their feelings for each other and the self-loathing that comes at the same time, as their mutual attraction grows.

When Itsuki is given a major role in the next play, Satoru works on the script as Itsuki concentrates on his performance. Satoru and Itsuki will come to terms with their true feelings, which they cannot hide anymore.

(Source: bamB!, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

110140.description:
Yuya Aida (25) and Rio Aihara (28) are in their second month of living together. More than lovers but less than married, they're still more or less content.

(Source: One Peace Books)

Notes:
- Includes five extra chapters.
- Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.
synonyms: The Two Gets by Tomorrow Too, More or Less.

title.native: ふたり明日もそれなりに

110141.description: A boy falls in love with a girl, who is the student council president of their school. After some investigation, he finds out that she has a repressed exhibitionism fetish.

title.native: 幼なじみオブザデッド

110143.description:
Through no fault of his own, a low-level hero somehow amasses a party powerful enough to take down the Demon Queen - but not only are they super strong, they're also super affectionate! These handsome men are gunning for his affection as much as they are helping him on his quest, whether he wants them to or not. Meanwhile at the lair, the Demon Queen is getting impatient over when her knight in shining armor will show up to challenge her...

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title.native: 底辺勇者だけど最強パーティのモテ主人公やってます。
title.romaji: Teihen Yuusha Dakedo Saikyou Party no Mote Shujinkou Yattemasu.

110144.description:
College student Otonari Otoya is a boy who lacks self-esteem and dreams of being reborn into a different dimension. One day while playing a [video] game, he accidentally clicks on an ad, and trips into another world?!?!

He's surprised but delighted, until he realizes that something's strange. A whole group of guys are treating him too kindly, almost like he's a girl! Could it be that the world Otonari was transported into... is an otome game?!?!

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.
synonyms: I ♂ Tripped into an Otome Game

title.native: 乙ゲーにトリップした俺♂
カッコイイ男キャラクター漫画教室！

110150.description: Hagiri Town is a lonely country town. People have sometimes avoided getting into that topic because of the unusual nature of 56 people missing in the past 30 years. Meanwhile, a male teacher, Gunji has been assigned to a high school in the town. Wherein he is responsible as class deputy and also to take over the floral arrangements club. As head of that club he receives a poisonous red flower from an old man who donates flowers to the school, but…this was the beginning of a nightmare that would change everything!

A pure but unusual love story of a girl who ventures into femdom.

(Source: Hox)

Published in magazine Monthly Afternoon, Issue 3, 2012.

110154.description:
Noda is a salaryman who is good at his job but has trouble socializing outside of work, and Arikari is a girl with a temper who falls for him. Then there is Ueshima, Noda's former classmate, whom Noda has a faint crush on. The story revolving around these three people will make you nod your head so hard that it might just fall off!

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

110156.description: After getting into a car accident, Seungeun gets transported into another world. An Empress from that world asks of him, “Won’t you be my concubine?” Seungeun bewilderingly replies,” … Huh? But I’m a man?” Who is this mysterious woman, why are emoticons popping up on her head? Will he be able to return home safely?

110157.description: In the future world, technology runs the universe. An intelligent robot committed many mistakes as he did not fully trust human beings. As his punishment, he lost his job and was sent back into the ancient times. However, the device had accidentally brought him back to Ancient China, where he met a cold yet beautiful snake demon. A series of stories unfold as the two were brought together by fate...

title.native: #ラストオーダー ー最後の選択ー

110159.description:
The near future, in a quiet seaside town. Yoshioka, who had recently lost his wife, just wants to spend the rest of his days in peace. However, Yoshioka's children, worried about their father's health, sent a housekeeping robot to help him. Yoshioka's quiet life is about to change.

(Source: Manba, translated)

Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

110160.description:
Misaki's been working for Malta Foods for a while now, with no prospects of moving up in the company. She finds Yuki hard to work with even though she had trained him when he was just a newbie. He keeps glaring at her now... Does he hate her or something? One day, Yuki sees Misaki's ex-boyfriend giving her a hard time, and suddenly, Yuki turns into a different man! His passionate kisses and the sensitive way his fingers caress the curves of her body both at the office and out of it give Yuki pleasure like she's never had before... He has her at his fingertips, physically and emotionally... and she just can't stop thinking about him!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: オレ、先輩のこと今から襲います。
title.romaji: Ore, Senpai no Koto Ima kara Osoimasu.

110161.description:
In order to continue his high school education, Asaoka Miki separates from the person who raised him and returns to his parents' home. Since he has always been compared to his talented and social younger twin, Itsuki, he has a deep inferiority complex towards his twin brother. After meeting and falling in love with Takagi Kazuya, someone who is seven years older than him, Miki's world changed completely. Takagi's love and kindness melts Miki's stubborn heart, and not too long after, Miki's blind faith in Takagi intensifies. For Miki, that was his first once-in-a-lifetime love he's ever experienced.
However, the person Takagi's after isn't Miki, but the boy who harshly rejected him. With Miki, Itsuki's lookalike and replacement, in his hands, will Takagi suddenly close in on Itsuki again....?

A love story between a piece of scum and a brave young man who are a few years apart.

110162.description:
During a high school field trip… there was a terrible accident. When Paloma woke up two moons graced the night sky and, next thing you know, she’s surrounded by vampires who think she’s their goddess?! Worse yet, what will they do if they discover she’s not? Welcome to the Vampire Academy.

(Source: Tapas)

110163.description: A story about a girl who finds a peculiar glasses store, and how those glasses change her.
synonyms: 眼鏡で少し変われた女の子の話

110164.description:
When Touya had his first wet dream, Naoto decided to teach his younger brother how to pleasure and release himself. Little did he know that the not-so-innocent act would lead to something else. Seeing his big brother having an orgasm made little Touya develop a desire to have his brother to himself, but knowing that it was a taboo, he kept it a secret close to his heart. But Naoto had his own bones to bury. A change in the family opened all the boxes and the secrets were laid bare on the table... Now they both have to find a way to deal with each other and move on.

Note: Includes two parts of "Renai Moratorium (恋愛モラトリアム)," and an extra chapter.

110165.description:
Daeho Han needs money to save his mother. Jihoon Nam wants revenge. The two join hands to take on the top 0.01% 'super rich' class.

(Source: Toomics)

110166.description:
Geon-U Dan has vowed to overthrow the status quo of the dysfunctional high school he recently transferred to, where rich and powerful third-generation chaebol heirs call the shots and gambling runs rampant. But does Geon-U have what it takes to beat the odds, defeat the Taekyeong Oh Family, and restore law and order to his high school?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

- Includes one extra chapter.
- Belongs to Blue String universe.

Collection of stories:

2. Yuusha ga Tensei shitara Maougun ni natta Ken. (KAYABUKI Naya)
3. Akuma Tsuki no Yakusoku (GENI Yuu)

That's the situation our main character, Kakura Norio, has gotten herself into. Join Norio-chan in her attempts to survive in a complicated isekai political situation, just like Satoki in +alpha no Tachiichi!

110171.description:
An official manga adaptation of the live-action Fox television series Prison Break

The suspense story is set in Fox River State Penitentiary, a maximum-security prison for the worst offenders. To rescue his older brother Lincoln (actor Dominic Purcell) who was framed for murder, Michael (Wentworth Miller) hatches an elaborate plan to enter and then break out of the prison.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: プリズン・ブレイク シーズン1

When a demon falls for an angel...

Long ago, a great war raged between the royal military forces of Lugnica and the demi-humans. A hero was born on that battlefield--the Sword Demon, Wilhelm Trias. This is the story of that legendary swordsman--and the woman he loved.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

The little egret is a bird who lives life bravely, perhaps Sang Shang will find his life's meaning by moving forward with him?

This year's 29th issue of Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine published a new 47-page one-shot manga of Kinnikuman by Yudetamago on Monday. The one-shot, titled "Sayonara, Kinnikuman!! no Maki" (The 'Goodbye, Kinnikuman' Story), is the first time the manga has returned to Weekly Shonen Jump in 11 years. The one-shot portrays the arrival of 10 supermen during Kinnikuman's retirement ceremony.

(Source: Anime News Network)

110185.description:
Aah, if I had do it all again, I'd rather die. Adventurer Lughys spent his days as a loser. Opporessed by his party members, so called "comrades", the road to being a hero or a legend was a long ways away. Then suddenly, a mysterious shadow called out for him, giving him the chance to return to his past, and told him he'd be given only one chance.

He longed for it—— This time, he'd obtain valor and honor, and love.

However, the god of fate would not permit it. A battle with a great magical beast, an attack on a noble house, challenging a quest with the hero—— For far and away from his expectations, he gets entagled after rescuing someone. Unbeknownst to him, his dream took a 180, and from the girls in his former party, came a twisted attachment and affection.

There's only one chance at this. ——Now, why not take back the future? Revenge dwelling in a dark, hot flame, and turning the tables in a Replay Fantasy.

Here at this secretive medical school, there is a ghost on the moonlit lake, the sound of a butcher's knife in the cafeteria, a cadaver coming back to life... and these events are only the tip of the iceberg. There are many more supernatural things just waiting to be discovered.

On his way home after drinking with friends, Tomoe finds a handsome, mysterious young man slumped on the street. He seems to be injured, so Tomoe takes him home, but things get intimate fast! In the morning, Tomoe wakes up to nothing but a pile of money on the table...! Enraged at the idea that he unwittingly sold his body, Tomoe goes looking for the guy. But, all he can recall about him is his beastly embrace, his hunger for human skin... and his ragged, desperate breathing as he whispers, "Give me your warmth"...

(Source: Renta!)

110190.description: “Usami-san to Kamei-kun" is a story about Usami, a high school girl who values rationality and efficiency, and Kamei-kun, the son of an actor who likes to do things at his own pace. Usami, a rather rash person when it comes to most things, fell in love at first sight with the childhood friend of Kamei, Takeshi. She goes right ahead and voices her feelings to him, thinking, "Rather than dawdling around, it's more efficient to confess!" Seeing that, Kamei warns her, "That will only be troublesome to him.”

Yuki Tanaka lives a poor but orderly life. One day, his electricity stops working all over his house. Suddenly a girl named Aoda appears in front of Yuki. Gods such as the god of poverty, the god Nado, and the god of disease also appeared. What will become of Yuki's good life?

(Source: Asahi Sonorama, translated)

Every Thursday, Kei receives packages to support her shut-in lifestyle. At her previous job, she was the victim of sexual harassment and has since found it difficult to be around other people, leading her to work freelance. Then she meets Rinko, the new delivery girl with a positive and cheerful personality. As their relationship begins to grow, so does Kei's curiosity for her.

Innocent, optimistic Mei Sahara goes home one day to find out that she’s engaged to be married to a man she’s never met as soon as she turns twenty – a few months from now! Good-looking, well-educated company president Hijiri Kamijo looks every bit the perfect prince straight out of a fairytale, but can Mei deal with him as he attempts to take all of her firsts?

(Source: Manga Planet)

110196.description:
Self-proclaimed otaku and shut-in Sakura Kisaragi would prefer to spend her days alone in her room, playing her favorite yakuza-themed dating simulator. But when she saves the life of an old man who turns out to be the head of the Amou-gumi crime family, she inadvertently earns a spot in the yakuza's succession plans-moved by her courage, the old man declares that whoever among his three ambitious grandsons can win her hand in marriage will be the next boss. Now kind but ailing Shusuke, brash hothead Reo, and cool and calculating Ryusei are all vying to make her their boss wife-but will she be anything more to them than a means to an end? Meanwhile, not everyone in the Amou-gumi organization is happy to have her there...

A high-stakes romcom from the author of A Springtime with Ninjas.

This manga anthology includes three stories, recommended and awarded by Hakusensha! The title work and the first story, "Hana Yanagi", is a heart wrenching love story that takes place in the red light district. The second story, "A Bird of Your Color", follows Tiana, a young woman with blue hair. Lastly "Dame Maid", a story of a hopelessly lacking maid and a cute and little young master.

Although she had traveled to the Royal Capital to train as a lady of the court, before she realized it, the daughter of an impoverished Earl was seen as nothing more than another one of the servants. It was during one of her usual morning cleaning rounds when by chance the Crown Prince Isaac, who was rumored for one reason or another to keep all women at arm's length, passed by, but...

When she tried to return the document he dropped, she got caught up in a maelstrom of trouble!?

And for that matter, what do you mean that all the women who approach the Crown Prince faint and fall over...!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Once she saw that, Rikka's memories resurfaced. It appears that this world was from an otome game her little sister used to play in her past life. Regardless, in order to save a childhood friend who sacrificed her body to protect him, Touru spent twenty-five years developing the skill. Once completed, the skill could completely defy the world’s common sense. Touru, the girl, the naughty child they picked up in a back alley, and the old landlord lady join together as companions, setting out on an adventure to become heroes. A man who lived through the depths of despair decided to move forward and widen his horizons.

Tohma Mikado, heir to Mikado Holdings has it all -fame, looks, wits and reputation. He's the dream guy everybody wants and girls fawn all over him. One day, Tohma gets ambushed by street goons which leads him to meeting his eccentric savior Fujimi who helps people as a hobby, without asking anything in return. Curious about Fujimi's kindness, Tohma insists that he pay him back and learn more about the man himself. It seems Fujimi is more than what meets the eye.

Highly praised by the creator Eiichi Oda himself!! A brand-new One Piece spin-off gag manga finally collected in a single volume!!!! Follow the lives of a group of high school students with the same names as the beloved Straw Hat Pirates, as they search for the treasure found in the joys and sorrows of daily life—and occasionally cause mayhem. A no-holds-barred spin-off gag manga by the Pacifista of the gag manga world, Daiki Ihara!!!!

110236.description:
In 1878, as the wave of Western culture spreads through Japan, in Nagasaki, Miyo, a girl orphaned in the Satsuma Rebellion works at a curio shop called Vingt. The dresses, sewing machines, binoculars, boots, and other items acquired at the Paris Exhibition by the proprietor KOURA Momotoshi have aroused her curiosity. Miyo accumulates experience in her job while using clairvoyant ability which she has possessed since she was very young. The story vibrantly depicts a new age that visits a Nagasaki thriving with merchants and prostitutes, centering on Miyo's changes as she begins to experience feelings for Momotoshi akin to the awakening of love, and Momotoshi's past, which gradually comes to light. Based on a thorough investigation of the history, things are depicted along with the colorful historical background of the period, and interesting facts about antiques that appear in the work are included as mini-columns. In these ways, the author's knowledge is well utilized, enhancing the manga's feeling of reality.

Notes:
- Winner of the 21st Japan Media Arts Excellence Award (2018).
- Winner of the Grand Prize category of the 24th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize (2020).

We’re supposed to be lovers “just by contract”, no more and no less than that, and yet… Masato, who has a mysterious skill (?!) of making men fall in love with him, ends up getting fired from his modeling job because of that very skill. Drastic love between super darling heir X complicated model!

The manga centers on Yamabuki Tatsumori, a new student at Momijidai High School, a nationally renowned boarding school that has produced world leaders and geniuses. 110251.description:
Sixteen-year-old Yanagisawa Yae is our very optimistic heroine. Even when she was given only two options to pick from—either to move overseas with her parents due to their jobs or to move to the countryside to stay closer to her grandparents, she chose the latter.

As she looked up the apartment she would be moving into, she ended up in a shrine. Since she is in the shrine anyways, she offers her prayer and tries out the fortune-notes. Incredibly, she picks up a "very good-luck" fortune-note yet it has only bad lucks written on it.

One day, at Osiris' behest, Set and his brother sneak out of the palace. The one moment Set takes his eyes off his brother, Osiris is assassinated. Suspected of treason, Set is condemned to be executed...or so he thought.

But when one of her followers appears in real life, she senses there might be more to their connection...and maybe she wants something more than a digital-only connection, after all...

Everything about Alice—her family, her friends, her life, even her crush—is ordinary, no Wonderland to see here. But lately, her dreams have been anything but ordinary. While asleep, she finds herself interrogated by two creepy marionettes, their glass eyes peering into the darkest corners of her heart.

“What is it you desire?”

Try as she might to ignore the dreams, Alice is drawn into their violent, twisted universe. As greed and desire begin to warp the ordinary reality she knows, Alice is thrust into a dark game of slaughter made for fairy-tale heroines who’ll stop at nothing to bring their creators back to life!

title.native: ペルソナ5 コミックアラカルト

110352.description:
The humorous and heartfelt autobiographical comic essay of an otaku manga artist! Follow her journey as she learns the ins and outs of pregnancy and childbirth.

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: I do not know how to give birth!

title.english: I Don't Know How to Give Birth!
title.native: 出産の仕方がわからない！

110357.description:
1-3. Home
"When I'm an adult, I'll definitely be back. So, wait for me in this house, okay?"
The novelist Tatsumi finds a boy in his garden one day. Despite not being good to children in general, Subaru was innocent and like a puppy, and Tatsumi became accustomed to the proximity of Subaru as they spent time together. But is not Subaru coming home? Until the puppy becomes a big dog... An extremely sweet love between an innocent child and a twisted adult.

4. Semai Sekai ni (せまいせかいに)
5. ENDLESS WELCOME BACK
6. feel at home

(Source: Closeted Fujoshis)

110358.description:
Teacher x High School Girl, Tutor x Junior High Student, Manager x Part-Timer, Older Brother x Younger Sister… Older men are being dominated by younger girls! This anthology is all about situations where the power relationship is reversed!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 年下女子にマウントされる アンソロジーコミック
title.romaji: Toshishita Joshi ni Mount sareru Anthology Comic

110363.description:
Yuuichi, the young master of a rich household, had always thought that there was something missing in his daily life. Could his interactions with his maid, Chiyoko, change this? A coming-of-age story drawn in a rough and sketchy style.

An original work, published as a doujinshi at C84

110365.description:
There's a small forest on the edge of town. People have long feared the forest after being told not to enter it, for they may not ever return. The reason: there's a scary wolf there...!?

This is a story of a gentle and hardworking wolf living together with the other forest animals.

Note: Chapter count includes 1 extra.
synonyms: The Wolf of the Small Forest

title.native: ちいさな森のオオカミちゃん
魔法科高校の劣等生 司波達也暗殺計画
title.romaji: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Shiba Tatsuya Ansatsu Keikaku

110367.description:
A Manhua of the popular smartphone game Honkai 3rd launched by miHoYo

「Collapse」 ... An unknown force once known bury the civilization of mankinds in the distant past ... now descended into this peaceful world once again.

"Honkai, the mysterious power responsible for destroying human civilization countless times, has descended upon this beautiful world once again…” With the lands now flooded with deadwalkers and Honkai beasts, a group of girls bearing the burdens of despair continue their fight onward. Will there be any hope of clinging to survival?"

Three years ago, the third Honkai descended upon Chuangai City in the far east... Under the glow of sunset, Valkyrie Kiana leapt out from the Hyperion, plummeting through the clouds like a falling meteor towards a warship. Her relentless Valkyrie determination represented a glimmer of hope. With this breathtaking scene, the story of the Captain and the Hyperion begins and the stage is set for the battle with the Honkai. Fight for all that is beautiful in this world!

title.native: 鳥獣ギ町のあるきかた

110369.description:
Tenjou Kouga is blessed with an affluent family, a famous former soccer player as a father, and an unyielding spirit. Kurose Takumi is a reticent and detached boy who has endured past hardships. When they meet, a new soccer legend will begin.

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

110370.description:
Manga adaptation of "THE IDOLM@STER Million Live! Theater Days" smartphone rhythm game, focusing on Yuriko Nanao, Momoko Suou and Konomi Baba.

Note: Chapter count includes prologue, one 0.5 chapter, three Christmas specials, and six volume omake chapters.
synonyms: 브랜 뉴 송 Brand New Song

title.native: アイドルマスター ミリオンライブ！ シアターデイズ ブランニューソング
title.romaji: The iDOLM@STER Million Live!: Theater Days - Brand New Song

110372.description:
I've been working at the company for three months now, and it's kind of lacklustre...all because of her..."
Assistant Manager Momozono has a big chest, a baby face, and a gentle voice. Moreover, she's capable at her job. Everyone around says she's the female boss they all want, but newbie Onishi just can't bring himself to like her... This is an office love comedy by the same author as "Koi to Yobu ni wa Kimochi Warui".
synonyms: He Does Not Like a Sweet Peach

title.romaji: Nigate na no wa Amai Momo

110373.description:
This is Table Land, a mystical world where fallen shooting stars take the form of a witch and are bound to a cat, so when the witch dies, so will the cat. This story begins with a witch's end, but with her still-living cat left behind, and another witch who fell from the skies, soon left alone by the death of her guardian. Forlorn, they both start their lonely search for a place to belong. Will the shadows of the past loom or will the light of hope shine bright? Embark with us now on this curious tale of Table Land...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Where the Shooting Star Falls, Wait There
在流星陨落的地方等待
Wait Where the Shooting Star Has Fallen
โปรดรออยู่ตรงนั้นในวันที่มีฝนดาวตก

title.english: Wait Where the Shooting Star Falls

110374.description:
The Jester ―― More commonly known as the ‘Playboy’ Dylan, was fired from the party of the Heroes. The self-centred Heroes didn’t understand Dylan’s importance to the group.

They were just a group of one-man teams. Not interested in cooperation at all. Any failures are blamed on the jester. Dylan, who was disgusted with such companions and was sick of playing as their comedic foil, happily accepted being kicked out. The Heroes didn’t know. After saving them many times over with his magic tricks, the level 99 jester can change his job title to that of a ‘Great Sage’. “Life, how about a rewrite?”

He’s done being the clown. From here on out, he’s going to take the leading role.

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.
synonyms: Did You Know That a Playboy Can Change His Job to a Sage? ~The Level 99 Jester Expelled from the Heroes' Party Will Become a 'Great Sage'~
ตัวตลกแล้วไง รู้มั้ยว่าข้าไร้เทียมทาน - ตัวตลกที่เลเวล 99 เเล้วจะสามารถเปลี่ยนอาชีพเป็นมหาปราชญ์ได้ -

title.romaji: Asobinin wa Kenja ni Tenshoku Dekiru tte Shittemashita?: Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou Sareta Lv99, "Taikenja" ni Naru

110375.description:
In another world, the skill I was bequeathed was――"Summon Kitchen"? Eh, what the heck is that?!

The Office Lady that got mixed up in a high school girl's summons to another word―Isarai Shiina. Unlike the warm welcome given to the high school Saintess, Shiina is forced to live in a corner of the royal palace with her mysterious and newly obtained "Summon Kitchen" skill.

Apparently, using the skill to cook food amasses points, which can then be used to evolve the "kitchen".
'With nothing better to do, and things being what they are, I might as well work towards getting my glorious dream kitchen!' but, despite her enthusiasm, Shiina was told to keep the contents of her skill a secret by her guardian knight, Hurst...
synonyms: This "Summon Kitchen" Skill is Amazing! ~Amassing Points By Cooking in Another World~

title.native: スキル『台所召喚』はすごい！～異世界でごはん作ってポイントためます～
title.romaji: Skill "Daidokoro Shoukan" wa Sugoi!: Isekai de Gohan Tsukutte Point Tamemasu

110376.description:
The Unrivaled Father and The Strongest Daughter.
The father's powers that is hidden under the guise of an average D-Rank is..?
The story of their bonds and the storm that awaits them begins!

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: If Only It's an Ideal Daughter, Would You Even Pamper the World's Strongest?
If Your Ideal Daughter Is the World Strongest, Would You Still Pamper Her?
Risou no Musume Nara Sekai Saikyou Demo Kawaii ga tte Kuremasu ka?

title.native: 理想の娘なら世界最強でも可愛がってくれますか?
title.romaji: Risou no Musume Nara Sekai Saikyou Demo Kawaigatte Kuremasu ka?

110377.description:
This story was published to commemorate the record of Rumiko Takahashi's manga series that have printed over 200 million copies worldwide.

(Source: Manga Rock)

110378.description:
Ayumu's boyfriend, Jun, is second-in-command of the Ryusei Association family. In order to prove her independence, Ayumu has been focusing on her metalwork apprenticeship for the past two years. She was supposed to return to Jun soon, but now, he's telling her to wait a little longer. While they've seen each other a few times during their separation, it's been months since the last time they met. Ayumu knows it was her choice to be with a guy from a different world, but she just can't shake off her anxiety... Enjoy the dangerous thrills of loving a mobster in this much-anticipated sequel of the smash-hit romance, "My Precious"!

(Source: Renta!)

110379.description:
The manga based on the hit light novel series, about an ordinary salaryman who cheats death and now must find his way in another world—as a great healer.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: 聖者無双 ～サラリーマン、異世界で生き残るために歩む道～
title.romaji: Seija Musou: Salaryman, Isekai de Ikinokoru Tame ni Ayumu Michi

110380.description:
One moment, a certain salaryman is on cloud nine, that promotion finally within his grasp, and the next, he’s keeled over pain, and that was all she wrote. Luckily for him, fate had a bit more to say. A world of magic, monsters, and other such life-shortening entities await his newly reincarnated self for a second shot at life. With nothing but his past-life experiences and sharp business skills to guide him in the foreign lands of Galdardia, he takes up the name Luciel and vows that his (next) demise will be from naught but old age. And what better way to avoid a(nother) gruesome death, than by taking up a nice, cushy job as a healer? But getting by in another world doesn’t come easy, or cheap. It’ll take a lot of blood, sweat, and tears to hone the skills he needs to make his way. But make it he will...or die (again) trying!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Invincible Saint ~ Salaryman, the path I walk to survive in this other world~

title.native: 聖者無双 ～サラリーマン、異世界で生き残るために歩む道～
title.romaji: Seija Musou: Salaryman, Isekai de Ikinokoru Tame ni Ayumu Michi

title.native: クロウ・レコード ＜Infinite Dendrogram Another＞

110385.description:
Natsuki is a short boy who happens to be dating a tall girl who get made fun of by their height difference.

Note: Published in COMIC Koh Vol. 4
synonyms: I Want to be Pampered by a Girl of Generous Girth

title.native: おっきな彼女に甘えたい

110387.description:
Fujihashi Ryo enjoys her job as an office worker well enough, but it doesn’t hold a candle to the exciting job of her childhood friend Mizuno Souma, who works as a fireman. He and his handsome buddies are more than happy to entertain ladies with their heroic tales. Ryo wants to set up Souma with a girl in her office, but he’s too much of a playboy to settle down…or so she thinks. It turns out that he has the hots for her, and when he rescues her from a fire in her building, a different kind of spark begins to fly!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Fire in His Fingertips: A Flirty Fireman Ravishes Me With His Smoldering Gaze
title.native: 指先から本気の熱情～チャラ男消防士はまっすぐな目で私を抱いた～
title.romaji: Yubisaki kara Honki no Netsujou: Charao Shouboushi wa Massugu na Me de Watashi wo Daita

110389.description:
A collection of Noroi Michiru one-shots published after 2000 with the motif of urban legends.

1. Himitsu no Diet (秘密のダイエット)
2. Yakitori Kidan (ヤキトリ奇談)

11. Chikagai no Kai (地下街の怪)

(Source: Trash-Up!!, translated)

110391.description:
"Shall we kiss?"

Gloria spends her days protecting the health and chastity of Shiori, a college student who is bad at communicating with others.

title.native: グロリアさんの美味しい純潔を守る日々
title.romaji: Gloria-san no Oishii Junketsu wo Mamoru Hibi

110392.description:
Reincarnated in a fantasy world, Dahlia immerses herself in the art of crafting magical items. Using manufacturing knowledge from her previous life and the skills her new father has taught her, she invents blow dryers and other specialized tools, finding pleasure in everyday activities. Dahlia won’t hang her head in depression like she used to. She’s determined to enjoy her second chance at life!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Magic Artisan Dahliya Won't Hang Her Head ~Dahliya Wilts No More~
